item.title: Many Iranians Are Glad the Fighting Has Paused. Some Hard-liners Aren’t.
item.summary: The most fervent backers of the Islamic republic believe pausing the war for negotiations risks squandering what they see as a hard-won upper hand.

item.title: Iran Tries to Grasp Economic Devastation of War, and Find a Way Past It
item.summary: The vast scale of destruction wrought by U.S. and Israeli bombardment will make sanctions relief all the more vital to Iran’s government as it tries to negotiate a peace agreement.

item.title: Iran Has Been Consistent in War. Will It Be Consistent in Peace Talks?
item.summary: While President Trump’s war aims have changed by the moment, Iran has stuck to firm demands. The question is whether it will compromise in peace negotiations.

item.title: In New War With Israel, Hezbollah Defies Notion That It Was Crippled
item.summary: The Iran-backed Lebanese militant group surprised many with the intensity of its attacks on Israel in the current conflict.

item.title: World Leaders Push to Save Iran Talks Amid Israel’s Attacks in Lebanon
item.summary: President Trump’s cease-fire with Iran appears at risk as Vice President JD Vance heads to Pakistan for discussions with Iranian officials.

item.title: What the Cease-Fire Means for Iran
item.summary: Emerging from weeks of U.S. and Israeli airstrikes, an emboldened Iran has 10 demands for talks during the tenuous cease-fire, according to Iranian state media. Our reporter Erika Solomon assesses Iran’s position.

item.title: New Evidence Further Implicates U.S. Missiles in Strikes That Killed 21 Civilians in Iran
item.summary: Additional images and video build on an earlier analysis, which the Pentagon has disputed, showing Precision Strike Missiles, or PrSMs, hit a sports hall and residential areas in the Iranian city of Lamerd.

item.title: Facing Many Crises, Pakistan Tries to End a Big One — in Iran
item.summary: A nation with a stalled economy, a terrorism problem and two hostile neighbors is set to host the first formal U.S.-Iranian talks since the war began.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon Plan Talks in D.C. as War Threatens U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire Deal
item.summary: Whether Israel’s conflict with Hezbollah, the Iran-backed militant group in Lebanon, is included in the Iran cease-fire is one of the major disputes rattling the truce.

item.title: U.S. Moves to Deport Son of Prominent Figure in Iranian Revolution
item.summary: Federal agents arrested a man whose mother served as a spokeswoman for the Islamist embassy captors during the hostage crisis that began in 1979.
